name: l5_small
purpose: TASKS 49 (lever 5), the user's (b) of 25 Oct ('Advies akkoord. We willen die labels nodig.'): the eight smaller of the ten large PAHs (34-48 atoms, 354-508 6-31G* functions; coronene, peropyrene and ovalene among them) from PAHdb geometry to analytic labels on the labels CCX53 once the cation run has ended, for chain 42's size test (its wait: probes/large_pah_ready.py). The one batch runner from /root/l5 (deploy_large_pah_ccx53.sh: jobs made on the server, ids equal to chain 42's lists, runner smokes from a psi4 job passed). 4 lanes x 8 threads, a 26 GiB cap each; l5_large follows.
command: CODE=/root/l5/modules/05_support_predictor/corpus IDS_FILE=ids_small.txt CAP_MB=26624 LABEL_ARGS='--max-memory 24000 --reuse-existing' bash probes/labels_batch_ccx53.sh /root/l5 L5S /root/cations_c/cations_ccx53.log '^=== \(CX\) all done'

estimate.basis: after the cations (~29 Oct evening): price_large_labels.py's lane hours at 8 threads (fit exponent 3.4 on the labels server's 387 molecules: 11-39 h, 20 h at 422 and 33 h at 486 functions from the same fit), largest first on 4 lanes = ~49 h, +10 % for the psi4 optimisations (an allowance, not measured)
